scope: Theorem 8.9 (Natural ordinary comparison) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 73. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The natural coefficient maps induce quasi- isomorphisms colim d C• cts(P3, x−d A) −→ C• cts(P3, Bhol) −→ C• cts(P3, Bpk). (8.12) They preserve products, constants, and coefficient-field descent, and remain quasi-isomorphisms with any profinite space of continuous parameters in the convention (8.1). Every Frobenius power, including the pth-power map, acts invertibly on these untwisted cohomology groups. Consequently there is the natural identification H∗ cts(P3, B0) ∼ = H∗ cts(P1 × GL2(Zp), k).
